title: Knotty Australian Lamb Kebabs
description: A nutty and savory Australian dish featuring lamb, oregano, and bhuna, perfect for midnight cravings. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, bhuna spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the quince paste with 2 tablespoons of water to create a glaze.
Brush the quince glaze onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Sprinkle toasted pine nuts over the kebabs and serve hot.
